studies.title: The kangaroo
studies.caption: Strong hind legs and a long tail shape the kangaroo's movement. These animals were familiar to Australia's peoples long before Europeans tried to describe them.
studies.prompt: Full-body eastern grey kangaroo Macropus giganteus resting alert on Australian open woodland floor, large hind feet and muscular tail contacting ground, small relaxed forearms, grey-brown fur, long ears. Natural side three-quarter view, no human pose, no joey needed, no extra limbs.
